name: @aliyun-supabase/mcp-server-supabase

tools.name: list_aliyun_supabase_projects
tools.description: Lists all Supabase projects deployed on the Aliyun platform. Use this to retrieve a list of existing projects with their basic information. If no projects are found in the default region (cn-hangzhou), try other regions obtained from the describe_regions tool.

region_id.description: Region ID (e.g., cn-hangzhou, cn-shanghai, cn-beijing, etc.)

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return

tools.name: get_supabase_project
tools.description: Gets details for a specific Supabase project on Aliyun platform.

project_id.description: The ID of the Supabase project.

tools.name: get_supabase_project_api_keys
tools.description: Gets the Supabase project API keys including anon key and serviceRoleKey.

region_id.description: The region ID where the instance is located.

tools.name: modify_supabase_project_security_ip_list
tools.description: Modify the IP whitelist for a Supabase project. You need to add the client IP address or IP address range to the whitelist before using the Supabase instance.

region_id.description: Region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions API to view available region IDs.

security_ip_list.description: Comma-separated list of IP addresses or CIDR blocks to add to the whitelist. Up to 1000 entries. Format: 10.23.12.24 (IP) or 10.23.12.24/24 (CIDR)

tools.name: reset_supabase_project_password
tools.description: Reset the database password for a Supabase project.

account_password.description: Database account password. Must contain at least three of the following: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, and special characters. Special characters include: !@#$%^&*()_+-=. Password length must be between 8 and 32 characters.

tools.name: create_supabase_project
tools.description: Create a new Supabase project on Aliyun platform.

project_name.description: Project name. Must be 1-128 characters long. Can only contain English letters, numbers, hyphens (-) and underscores (_). Must start with an English letter or underscore (_).

zone_id.description: Zone ID. You can call the DescribeRegions API to view available zone IDs.

account_password.description: Initial account password. Must contain at least three of the following: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, and special characters. Special characters include: !@#$%^&*()_+-=. Password length must be between 8 and 32 characters.

security_ip_list.description: IP whitelist. 127.0.0.1 means禁止任何外部 IP 访问, you can modify the IP whitelist after the instance is created by calling the ModifySecurityIps API.

vpc_id.description: VPC ID. You can call the DescribeRdsVpcs API to view available VPC IDs. This parameter is required.

v_switch_id.description: vSwitch ID. vSwitchId is required. The zone where the vSwitch is located must be consistent with ZoneId.

region_id.description: Region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions API to view available region IDs.

storage_size.description: Storage space size in GB, default is 1GB.

disk_performance_level.description: Cloud disk PL level, default is PL0.

client_token.description: Idempotency check. For more information, see How to Ensure Idempotency.

tools.name: delete_supabase_project
tools.description: Delete a Supabase project on Aliyun platform.

project_id.description: Supabase project ID. You can log in to the console Supabase page to get the workspace ID.

region_id.description: The region ID where the instance is located.

tools.name: describe_regions
tools.description: Describe available regions and zones for Aliyun Supabase projects.

tools.name: describe_rds_vpcs
tools.description: Describe available VPCs in Aliyun for Supabase project deployment

region_id.description: Region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions API to view available region IDs.

tools.name: describe_rds_vswitches
tools.description: Describe available vSwitches in Aliyun for Supabase project deployment

region_id.description: Region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions API to view available region IDs.

zone_id.description: Zone ID. Must be consistent with the zone where the Supabase instance will be deployed.

vpc_id.description: VPC ID. The VPC where the vSwitches are located.

tools.name: execute_sql
tools.description: Executes custom SQL queries on a Supabase project database via the TypeScript fetch interface. Requires PublicConnectUrl and serviceRoleKey.

url.description: PublicConnectUrl for the Supabase project

tools.name: execute_sql_file
tools.description: Executes SQL from a local file. Use this instead of execute_sql for large SQL files (e.g. database functions over 5KB) to avoid MCP transport size limits. Reads the file from disk and runs it against the Supabase project database.

url.description: PublicConnectUrl for the Supabase project

file_path.description: Absolute path to the SQL file on the local filesystem

tools.name: list_table
tools.description: Lists all tables in specified schemas of a Supabase project database. By default lists all non-system tables, but can filter by schema. Uses the TypeScript fetch interface. Requires the project's PublicConnectUrl as url and serviceRoleKey as api_key obtained from other tools.

url.description: PublicConnectUrl for the Supabase project

schemas.description: List of schema names to filter tables. If not specified, returns all non-system schemas.

tools.name: list_columns
tools.description: Lists all columns in a table with detailed metadata including data type, nullable status, default values, and constraints. Requires the project's PublicConnectUrl as url and serviceRoleKey as api_key obtained from other tools.

url.description: PublicConnectUrl for the Supabase project

table_name.description: The name of the table to list columns from

tools.name: list_indexes
tools.description: Lists all indexes on tables in a schema including index name, table name, and index definition. Requires the project's PublicConnectUrl as url and serviceRoleKey as api_key obtained from other tools.

url.description: PublicConnectUrl for the Supabase project

tools.name: list_extensions
tools.description: Lists all PostgreSQL extensions installed in the database. Shows extension name, version, schema, and description. Requires the project's PublicConnectUrl as url and serviceRoleKey as api_key obtained from other tools.

url.description: PublicConnectUrl for the Supabase project

tools.name: deploy_edge_function
tools.description: Deploys an Edge Function to a Supabase project on Aliyun. Requires the project's PublicConnectUrl as url and serviceRoleKey as api_key obtained from other tools. The TypeScript file must be named index.ts.

url.description: PublicConnectUrl for the Supabase project (e.g., https://sbp-xxx.supabase.opentrust.net)

file_content.description: The content of the function file to deploy. The file must be named index.ts.

tools.name: list_edge_functions
tools.description: Lists all Edge Functions in a Supabase project on Aliyun. Requires the project's PublicConnectUrl as url and serviceRoleKey as api_key obtained from other tools.

url.description: PublicConnectUrl for the Supabase project (e.g., https://sbp-xxx.supabase.opentrust.net)

tools.name: invoke_edge_function
tools.description: Invokes an Edge Function in a Supabase project on Aliyun. Requires the project's PublicConnectUrl as url and anon key for authentication.

url.description: PublicConnectUrl for the Supabase project (e.g., https://sbp-xxx.supabase.opentrust.net)

data.description: Optional JSON data to send as request body

tools.name: delete_edge_function
tools.description: Deletes an Edge Function from a Supabase project on Aliyun. Requires the project's PublicConnectUrl as url and serviceRoleKey as api_key obtained from other tools.

url.description: PublicConnectUrl for the Supabase project (e.g., https://sbp-xxx.supabase.opentrust.net)

tools.name: list_auth_users
tools.description: Lists all authentication users in a Supabase project on Aliyun. Requires the project's PublicConnectUrl as url and serviceRoleKey as api_key obtained from other tools. Uses Supabase Admin API to retrieve user information.

url.description: PublicConnectUrl for the Supabase project (e.g., https://sbp-xxx.supabase.opentrust.net)

api_key.description: serviceRoleKey for authentication (required for Admin API access)

per_page.description: Number of users per page (default: 50, max: 1000)

tools.name: get_auth_user
tools.description: Retrieves details for a specific user in a Supabase project on Aliyun. Requires the project's PublicConnectUrl as url and serviceRoleKey as api_key obtained from other tools. Uses Supabase Admin API to retrieve user information.

url.description: PublicConnectUrl for the Supabase project (e.g., https://sbp-xxx.supabase.opentrust.net)

api_key.description: serviceRoleKey for authentication (required for Admin API access)

user_id.description: The ID of the user to retrieve

tools.name: create_auth_user
tools.description: Creates a new user using Supabase Admin API in a Supabase project on Aliyun. Requires the project's PublicConnectUrl as url and serviceRoleKey as api_key obtained from other tools.

url.description: PublicConnectUrl for the Supabase project (e.g., https://sbp-xxx.supabase.opentrust.net)

api_key.description: serviceRoleKey for authentication (required for Admin API access)

email_confirm.description: Whether to confirm the email address (default: false)

phone_confirm.description: Whether to confirm the phone number (default: false)

tools.name: delete_auth_user
tools.description: Deletes a user using Supabase Admin API in a Supabase project on Aliyun. Requires the project's PublicConnectUrl as url and serviceRoleKey as api_key obtained from other tools.

url.description: PublicConnectUrl for the Supabase project (e.g., https://sbp-xxx.supabase.opentrust.net)

api_key.description: serviceRoleKey for authentication (required for Admin API access)

user_id.description: The ID of the user to delete

tools.name: update_auth_user
tools.description: Updates user details using Supabase Admin API in a Supabase project on Aliyun. Requires the project's PublicConnectUrl as url and serviceRoleKey as api_key obtained from other tools.

url.description: PublicConnectUrl for the Supabase project (e.g., https://sbp-xxx.supabase.opentrust.net)

api_key.description: serviceRoleKey for authentication (required for Admin API access)

user_id.description: The ID of the user to update

email.description: New email address for the user

phone.description: New phone number for the user

email_confirm.description: Whether to confirm the email address

phone_confirm.description: Whether to confirm the phone number

tools.name: list_storage_buckets
tools.description: Lists all storage buckets in a Supabase project on Aliyun. Requires the project's PublicConnectUrl as url and serviceRoleKey as api_key obtained from other tools.

url.description: PublicConnectUrl for the Supabase project (e.g., https://sbp-xxx.supabase.opentrust.net)

tools.name: create_storage_bucket
tools.description: Creates a new storage bucket in a Supabase project on Aliyun. Requires the project's PublicConnectUrl as url and serviceRoleKey as api_key obtained from other tools.

url.description: PublicConnectUrl for the Supabase project (e.g., https://sbp-xxx.supabase.opentrust.net)

name.description: Name of the bucket to create

public.description: Whether the bucket should be public (default: false)

tools.name: delete_storage_bucket
tools.description: Deletes a storage bucket from a Supabase project on Aliyun. Requires the project's PublicConnectUrl as url and serviceRoleKey as api_key obtained from other tools.

url.description: PublicConnectUrl for the Supabase project (e.g., https://sbp-xxx.supabase.opentrust.net)

bucket_name.description: Name of the bucket to delete

tools.name: list_storage_files
tools.description: Lists files in a storage bucket in a Supabase project on Aliyun. Requires the project's PublicConnectUrl as url and serviceRoleKey as api_key obtained from other tools.

url.description: PublicConnectUrl for the Supabase project (e.g., https://sbp-xxx.supabase.opentrust.net)

limit.description: Maximum number of files to return

tools.name: upload_storage_file
tools.description: Uploads a file to a storage bucket in a Supabase project on Aliyun. Requires the project's PublicConnectUrl as url and serviceRoleKey as api_key obtained from other tools.

url.description: PublicConnectUrl for the Supabase project (e.g., https://sbp-xxx.supabase.opentrust.net)

file_path.description: Path where the file should be stored in the bucket

file_content.description: Content of the file to upload (as base64 encoded string or plain text)

upsert.description: Whether to overwrite if file already exists (default: false)

tools.name: download_storage_file
tools.description: Downloads a file from a storage bucket in a Supabase project on Aliyun. Requires the project's PublicConnectUrl as url and serviceRoleKey as api_key obtained from other tools.

url.description: PublicConnectUrl for the Supabase project (e.g., https://sbp-xxx.supabase.opentrust.net)

file_path.description: Path of the file to download

tools.name: delete_storage_file
tools.description: Deletes one or more files from a storage bucket in a Supabase project on Aliyun. Requires the project's PublicConnectUrl as url and serviceRoleKey as api_key obtained from other tools.

url.description: PublicConnectUrl for the Supabase project (e.g., https://sbp-xxx.supabase.opentrust.net)

file_path.description: Path(s) of the file(s) to delete. Can be a single path or an array of paths.
